name.description: Official display name of the school campus.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier used as default for school events.

allowPublicDiscovery.description: Whether public events for this school are visible without authentication.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest school configuration update.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last updated school settings.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: School-scoped user membership and role assignment record.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

schoolId.description: School identifier this membership belongs to.

displayName.description: Optional display label for organizer roster management.

email.description: Optional member email visible only to the member and school admins.

assignedBy.description: UID of the administrator who created or updated this membership.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when membership was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when membership was last updated.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: A school club meeting or campus event stored in Cloud Firestore.

id.description: Unique event identifier matching document ID.

title.description: Display title of the school event.

hostClub.description: Name of the student organization or club hosting the event.

clubId.description: Normalized slug identifier for the hosting club.

startAt.description: Scheduled start timestamp stored as Firestore Timestamp.

endAt.description: Scheduled end timestamp stored as Firestore Timestamp.

timezone.description: IANA timezone in which the event was scheduled.

location.description: Campus room, building, or field where the event takes place.

imageUrl.description: Validated HTTPS cover image URL or curated local asset path.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the organizer who created the event.

rsvpCount.description: Total number of students who have RSVPed to the event.

discoverKey.description: Rule-enforced query partition key (public:<schoolId> | school:<schoolId> | draft:<uid>).

isDemoSeed.description: Indicates demo content seeded or migrated by an administrator.

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp recorded when an event was cancelled.

cancellationReason.description: Optional organizer note explaining why the event was cancelled.

Attendee.title: Attendee
Attendee.description: An RSVP record linking a signed-in student UID to an event.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the attending student.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student RSVPed.

UserMembership.title: UserMembership
UserMembership.description: Admin-managed role mirror keyed by UID for index-free and rule-safe Firestore list queries.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

schoolId.description: School identifier assigned to this user.

assignedBy.description: UID of the administrator who updated this record.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/schools/{schoolId}/members/{uid}.description: School-scoped RBAC membership documents mapping user UIDs to student, organizer, or admin roles.

/userMemberships/{uid}.description: Admin-maintained role mirror used by Firestore list queries.

/events/{eventId}.description: Campus events created and managed by authorized organizers and administrators.

/events/{eventId}/attendees/{attendeeId}.description: Subcollection tracking individual student RSVPs keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
